annotation.title_clean: Council Resolution on the second cycle of the strategic framework for European cooperation in education and training towards the European Education Area (2026-2030)
annotation.title_en: Council Resolution on the second cycle of the strategic framework for European cooperation in education and training towards the European Education Area (2026-2030)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C series (C/2026/3720)
named_instruments_referenced: Council Resolution on strategic framework for European cooperation in education and training (2021-2030)
annotation.summary_en: Council of the EU resolution setting the second cycle (2026-2030) of the European Education Area strategic framework, with six strategic priorities (basic skills, digital and citizenship education, lifelong learning and mobility, the teaching profession, VET, higher education), EU-level targets and governance arrangements. AI comes up only as digital skills and its ethical, responsible use in education.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets six strategic priorities for EU cooperation in education and training for 2026-2030
Sets EU-level targets on basic skills, digital skills, early school leaving, STEM enrolment and mobility
Calls for knowledge of AI and its ethical, responsible use within digital education
Keeps the existing governance structure (High Level Group, working groups, open method of coordination)
Invites the Commission to report progress and propose a framework for the following decade in 2030
